Karnataka CM Announces Second Bengaluru Airport Location in South

Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah has announced that the location for Bengaluru's second airport will be in the southern part of the city. This decision marks a significant development for the region's infrastructure and connectivity. The announcement was made by the Chief Minister, indicating a key step in the planning process for the new airport.
